pulse.currentFocus: S288 completed the continuous full /arc: seven live-code-verified audit items and seven generated second-order innovations shipped. The proprietary-first /ip/ route completes the universal sitemap. Remote browser evidence drove measured first-paint root fixes for /changelog/ and /studio-pulse/; the expanded CLS matrix passes 12/12.
